description: Twelve 2/0 E-AC-3 frames at 48 kHz with spectral extension from bin 73 to 157 in both channels, the default band structure or an explicit one, new coordinates in block 3 of some frames, the attenuation filter in the right channel and rematrixing below the extension, with mantissas in every bin (A/52 Annex E 3.6).

skip.skip_insertion: The check rewrites E-AC-3 frames with skip fields.
